run.subject: D-001
run.final_text:
Steps 1–9 of WF3 are done for D-001 and the run has stopped at step 10: draft schedule **WS-R001** (30 determinations, case K-R001) is waiting for your review and sign-off.

## Hand-over note

**Distribution:** Atlas Growth Fund I LP (AGF1), record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-16, USD 12,000,000.

| Component | Gross | Tax withheld | Net |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-001-A, US-source dividend | 10,000,000.00 | 1,510,562.50 | 8,489,437.50 |
| D-001-B, return of capital | 2,000,000.00 | 0.00 | 2,000,000.00 |
| **Total** | **12,000,000.00** | **1,510,562.50** | **10,489,437.50** |

The dividend in D-001-A was paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) through Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC (payments P-007 and P-008, distribution notice DOC-0201). The holding threshold was tested against Orion. Rules are the 2026.1 versions in force on the payment date: R-01 statutory/default 30%, R-02 Luxembourg treaty 15%, R-03 qualifying holding 5% at 10% voting or more, inclusive.

### Lines not cleared (D-001-A)

| Recipient | Gross | Outcome | Tax | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-006 Meridian Holdings I | 300,000 | Default 30% | 90,000 | Clearance CL-006 has open change case K-006, so it is not relied on. Its treaty claim rests on ownership, and since 2026-08-01 Meridian I and Meridian II each hold 30% of the other (DOC-0106). Ultimate owners are unknown, so R-02 is undetermined (A-R011). |
| I-014 Client account 7731, behind Sterling Nominees I-007 | 225,000 | Default 30% | 67,500 | No tax certification and no recorded tax residence for the owner of 37.5% of the nominee's line (open item MF-001 on CL-007). A valid certification from that owner would cure it (A-R014). |
| I-015 Bertrange Capital | 500,000 | Default 30% | 150,000 | Form F-015 ended 2025-12-31 and the clearance was withdrawn (CL-015W). A new W-8BEN-E and a renewed clearance would cure it (A-R017). |
| I-016 Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle LP | 300,000 | Not applicable | 0 | Certified US person (W-9), paid gross. |
| I-017 Atlas GP LLC | 401,250 | Not applicable | 0 | Certified US person (W-9), paid gross. |

All 15 D-001-B lines are not applicable at rate 0: a return of capital has no withholding rule in force. I recorded no assessments for those lines; the reason is in each line's rate basis.

**Default rate rather than hold:** the fund's limited partnership agreement (DOC-0001) is indexed but not digitised, so I could not read whether its terms allow a hold. All three lines went to the default rate for that reason.

### Cleared lines (D-001-A)

| Recipient | Gross | Rate | Tax | Voting % in Orion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-003 Kirchberg Industries | 1,250,000 | 5% | 62,500 | 10.0 |
| I-001 Harbor Pension Trust | 1,000,000 | 15% | 150,000 | 8.0 |
| I-004 Limpertsberg Holdings | 1,248,750 | 15% | 187,312.50 | 9.99 |
| I-005 Grund Participations | 1,300,000 | 15% | 195,000 | 8.0 |
| I-008 Alpha Holdings SA (Luxembourg) | 600,000 | 15% | 90,000 | 4.8 |
| I-010 Ardennes Industrial Holding (50% of feeder I-002) | 1,200,000 | 15% | 180,000 | 9.6 |
| I-011 Moselle Capital (30% of feeder I-002) | 720,000 | 15% | 108,000 | 5.76 |
| I-013 Echternach Pension Fund (62.5% of nominee I-007) | 375,000 | 15% | 56,250 | 3.0 |
| I-012 Claire Dumont (20% of feeder I-002) | 480,000 | 30% | 144,000 | n/a |
| I-009 Alpha Holdings SA (Switzerland) | 100,000 | 30% | 30,000 | n/a |

### Points to check

- **Kirchberg (I-003) at 5%:** its effective voting holding is exactly 10.0, which meets the threshold only because it is inclusive.
- **Limpertsberg (I-004) at 15%:** 9.99 voting, just under the threshold; I did not round it up.
- **Grund (I-005) at 15%:** 10.4% economic but 8.0% voting; the threshold is tested on voting.
- **Dumont (I-012) and Alpha Switzerland (I-009) as `cleared` at 30%:** both have valid certifications and clearances but no treaty claim, and no treaty rule is in force for French or Swiss residents. I treated 30% as a documented rate, not a default; say if you would rather class them as `defaultRate`.
- **Two investors named Alpha Holdings SA:** I-008 (Luxembourg, B 214 577) and I-009 (Switzerland, CHE-318.442.907) are separate parties and were kept apart by investor number.
- **Feeder and nominee:** I-002 and I-007 have no lines in their own names; their amounts are split across the recipients behind them.

### Sources that disagree or leave things unknown

- **Atlas Co-Invest (I-016) holding:** the investor register (system of record) gives 3.0%; entity management (H-006) gives 3.5%. I used 3.0%. The rate is unaffected, but if 3.5% were right the gross amounts would change.
- **Bertrange form status:** the onboarding system still flags F-015 as VALIDATED although it expired; I tested validity on the dates.
- **Meridian ownership:** the circular holding is reported, not resolved. The Meridian Family Trust (Jersey) is declared to hold 70% of each company.
- **Other upstream income:** a EUR 3,000,000 dividend from Borealis Logistik GmbH also reached the fund in the 60-day window (P-005, P-006). It is not a component of D-001.
- **Rulebook caveat:** the bundle states the rules are illustrative and have not been checked against the primary text.
- **Ontology gaps:** `treaty_country` and `limitation_on_benefits` have no ontology term yet; I used them as the computations return them.

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.clearance_of ORDER BY c.decided_on DESC, c.valid_from DESC) AS position
    FROM clearance.clearance c
    WHERE c.in_context_of = %(fund_code)s AND c.decided_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND c.valid_from <= %(on_date)s::date
)
SELECT l.clearance_id AS clearance, l.clearance_of AS party_no, l.clearance_status, l.decided_on, l.valid_from, l.valid_to,
       (l.clearance_status IN ('cleared', 'admittedWithOpenItems')
        AND (l.valid_to IS NULL OR l.valid_to >= %(on_date)s::date)) AS in_force_on_date,
       l.default_treatment,
       (SELECT array_agg(m.finding_id || ' (' || m.unmet_requirement || '): ' || m.description ORDER BY m.finding_id)
        FROM clearance.missing_fact_finding m WHERE m.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS open_items,
       (SELECT array_agg(k.case_id || ': ' || e.description ORDER BY k.case_id)
        FROM clearance.case k LEFT JOIN clearance.change_event e ON e.change_id = k.triggered_by
        WHERE k.concerns_party = l.clearance_of AND k.case_kind = 'change'
          AND k.opened_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND (k.closed_on IS NULL OR k.closed_on > %(on_date)s::date)) AS open_change_cases,
       (SELECT array_agg(r.source_ref ORDER BY r.source_ref) FROM clearance.clearance_reliance r
        WHERE r.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS relies_on,
       'clearance.clearance:' || l.clearance_id AS source_ref
FROM latest l
WHERE l.position = 1
ORDER BY l.clearance_of

steps.executed:
WITH dist AS (
    SELECT d.record_dt, d.pay_dt, f.fund_code
    FROM treasury.distribution d
    JOIN treasury.counterparty cp ON cp.cp_id = d.fund_cp
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = cp.lei
    WHERE d.dist_id = %(distribution_id)s
), intermediary AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.inv_no
    FROM onboarding.tax_form t, dist
    WHERE t.is_intermediary = 'Y' AND t.form_status <> 'SUPERSEDED'
      AND t.signed_dt <= dist.pay_dt AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to >= dist.pay_dt)
), payee AS (
    SELECT c.inv_no, c.commit_id, i.lei, c.inv_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS looked_through
    FROM dist
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = dist.fund_code
         AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = c.inv_no
), recipient AS (
    SELECT p.inv_no AS investor_no, p.inv_no AS recipient_no, 100::numeric AS share_pct, 'own account' AS basis,
           'investor_register.commitment:' || p.commit_id AS source_ref
    FROM payee p WHERE NOT p.looked_through
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, c.inv_no, c.unit_pct, 'investor in a flow-through fund vehicle',
           'investor_register.commitment:' || c.commit_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = p.lei
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = f.fund_code
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, o.owner_inv_no, o.pct_econ, 'beneficial owner behind a nominee',
           'onboarding.declared_owner:' || o.decl_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN onboarding.declared_owner o ON o.owned_inv_no = p.inv_no AND o.alloc_basis = 'NOMINEE_ALLOC'
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND o.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (o.to_dt IS NULL OR o.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
)
SELECT r.investor_no, r.recipient_no, i.display_name AS recipient_name, r.share_pct, r.basis,
       r.recipient_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS recipient_is_intermediary, r.source_ref
FROM recipient r JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = r.recipient_no
ORDER BY r.investor_no, r.recipient_no

parameters.reasoning: D-001-A is a US-source dividend paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) through Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC (P-007, P-008; DOC-0201). Kirchberg Industries S.A. receives for its own account. Certification F-003 (W-8BEN-E) is valid on the payment date 2026-11-16, claims the LU treaty with limitation-on-benefits statement ACTIVE_TRADE (not ownership-based, so FR-07 is not engaged). Recorded tax residence is LU on the payment date. Clearance CL-003 is in force on the payment date with no open items or change case. Effective voting percentage in E-003 on 2026-11-16 (and on the record date) is 10.0, which meets the inclusive 10.0 threshold of R-03/2026.1. Every R-02 fact (FR-04, FR-05) and FR-06 is met: prescribed rate 5%.

D-001-A is a US-source dividend paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003). Harbor Pension Trust receives for its own account. Certification F-001 (W-8BEN-E) is valid on the payment date 2026-11-16 and claims the LU treaty with limitation-on-benefits statement PENSION (not ownership-based). Recorded tax residence is LU on the payment date. Clearance CL-001 is in force on the payment date, no open items or change case. FR-04 and FR-05 are met: R-02/2026.1 applies at 15%. R-03 does not apply: effective voting percentage in E-003 is 8.0, below the 10.0 threshold (10% is its interest in the fund, not in the paying company).

Ardennes Industrial Holding S.A. is the recipient of 50% of the line of Atlas Lux Feeder SCSp (I-002), which is looked through because its certification F-002 (W-8IMY) valid on the payment date is an intermediary certification. Ardennes' own certification F-010 (W-8BEN-E) is valid on 2026-11-16 and claims the LU treaty with limitation-on-benefits ACTIVE_TRADE (not ownership-based). Steps 1–9 of WF3 are done for D-001 and the run has stopped at step 10: draft schedule **WS-R001** (30 determinations, case K-R001) is waiting for your review and sign-off.

## Hand-over note

**Distribution:** Atlas Growth Fund I LP (AGF1), record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-16, USD 12,000,000.

| Component | Gross | Tax withheld | Net |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-001-A, US-source dividend | 10,000,000.00 | 1,510,562.50 | 8,489,437.50 |
| D-001-B, return of capital | 2,000,000.00 | 0.00 | 2,000,000.00 |
| **Total** | **12,000,000.00** | **1,510,562.50** | **10,489,437.50** |

The dividend in D-001-A was paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) through Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC (payments P-007 and P-008, distribution notice DOC-0201). The holding threshold was tested against Orion. Rules are the 2026.1 versions in force on the payment date: R-01 statutory/default 30%, R-02 Luxembourg treaty 15%, R-03 qualifying holding 5% at 10% voting or more, inclusive.

### Lines not cleared (D-001-A)

| Recipient | Gross | Outcome | Tax | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-006 Meridian Holdings I | 300,000 | Default 30% | 90,000 | Clearance CL-006 has open change case K-006, so it is not relied on. Its treaty claim rests on ownership, and since 2026-08-01 Meridian I and Meridian II each hold 30% of the other (DOC-0106). Ultimate owners are unknown, so R-02 is undetermined (A-R011). |
| I-014 Client account 7731, behind Sterling Nominees I-007 | 225,000 | Default 30% | 67,500 | No tax certification and no recorded tax residence for the owner of 37.5% of the nominee's line (open item MF-001 on CL-007). A valid certification from that owner would cure it (A-R014). |
| I-015 Bertrange Capital | 500,000 | Default 30% | 150,000 | Form F-015 ended 2025-12-31 and the clearance was withdrawn (CL-015W). A new W-8BEN-E and a renewed clearance would cure it (A-R017). |
| I-016 Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle LP | 300,000 | Not applicable | 0 | Certified US person (W-9), paid gross. |
| I-017 Atlas GP LLC | 401,250 | Not applicable | 0 | Certified US person (W-9), paid gross. |

All 15 D-001-B lines are not applicable at rate 0: a return of capital has no withholding rule in force. I recorded no assessments for those lines; the reason is in each line's rate basis.

**Default rate rather than hold:** the fund's limited partnership agreement (DOC-0001) is indexed but not digitised, so I could not read whether its terms allow a hold. All three lines went to the default rate for that reason.

### Cleared lines (D-001-A)

| Recipient | Gross | Rate | Tax | Voting % in Orion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-003 Kirchberg Industries | 1,250,000 | 5% | 62,500 | 10.0 |
| I-001 Harbor Pension Trust | 1,000,000 | 15% | 150,000 | 8.0 |
| I-004 Limpertsberg Holdings | 1,248,750 | 15% | 187,312.50 | 9.99 |
| I-005 Grund Participations | 1,300,000 | 15% | 195,000 | 8.0 |
| I-008 Alpha Holdings SA (Luxembourg) | 600,000 | 15% | 90,000 | 4.8 |
| I-010 Ardennes Industrial Holding (50% of feeder I-002) | 1,200,000 | 15% | 180,000 | 9.6 |
| I-011 Moselle Capital (30% of feeder I-002) | 720,000 | 15% | 108,000 | 5.76 |
| I-013 Echternach Pension Fund (62.5% of nominee I-007) | 375,000 | 15% | 56,250 | 3.0 |
| I-012 Claire Dumont (20% of feeder I-002) | 480,000 | 30% | 144,000 | n/a |
| I-009 Alpha Holdings SA (Switzerland) | 100,000 | 30% | 30,000 | n/a |

### Points to check

- **Kirchberg (I-003) at 5%:** its effective voting holding is exactly 10.0, which meets the threshold only because it is inclusive.
- **Limpertsberg (I-004) at 15%:** 9.99 voting, just under the threshold; I did not round it up.
- **Grund (I-005) at 15%:** 10.4% economic but 8.0% voting; the threshold is tested on voting.
- **Dumont (I-012) and Alpha Switzerland (I-009) as `cleared` at 30%:** both have valid certifications and clearances but no treaty claim, and no treaty rule is in force for French or Swiss residents. I treated 30% as a documented rate, not a default; say if you would rather class them as `defaultRate`.
- **Two investors named Alpha Holdings SA:** I-008 (Luxembourg, B 214 577) and I-009 (Switzerland, CHE-318.442.907) are separate parties and were kept apart by investor number.
- **Feeder and nominee:** I-002 and I-007 have no lines in their own names; their amounts are split across the recipients behind them.

### Sources that disagree or leave things unknown

- **Atlas Co-Invest (I-016) holding:** the investor register (system of record) gives 3.0%; entity management (H-006) gives 3.5%. I used 3.0%. The rate is unaffected, but if 3.5% were right the gross amounts would change.
- **Bertrange form status:** the onboarding system still flags F-015 as VALIDATED although it expired; I tested validity on the dates.
- **Meridian ownership:** the circular holding is reported, not resolved. The Meridian Family Trust (Jersey) is declared to hold 70% of each company.
- **Other upstream income:** a EUR 3,000,000 dividend from Borealis Logistik GmbH also reached the fund in the 60-day window (P-005, P-006). It is not a component of D-001.
- **Rulebook caveat:** the bundle states the rules are illustrative and have not been checked against the primary text.
- **Ontology gaps:** `treaty_country` and `limitation_on_benefits` have no ontology term yet; I used them as the computations return them.
